description: This is a test module for the litellm vector store registry, containing unit tests for registry methods, credential retrieval, and search functionality.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: A class representing a managed vector store with attributes such as ID, provider, name, credentials, and timestamps.

classes.name: VectorStoreRegistry
classes.description: A registry class managing a collection of vector stores, allowing credential retrieval and addition of new stores.

methods.name: test_get_credentials_for_vector_store()
methods.description: Test that the registry correctly retrieves credentials for a specified vector store ID and returns empty dict if the store doesn't exist.

methods.name: test_add_vector_store_to_registry()
methods.description: Test adding new vector stores to the registry, including duplicate prevention.

methods.name: test_search_uses_registry_credentials()
methods.description: Test that the search function correctly obtains credentials from the registry and uses them in the search handler invocation.
